author: Honours
body:
Age: 19

Timezone: Pacific UTC-08:00 also I'm AU tbh on alot 

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes 

Do you have Discord? Yes honours#1667

Do you have access to a recording software? I do have access to recording software



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?
Yes I do. I have been a Co-owner on a server. Was a "SR Mod" on another server before it's sad downfall I've also been helper on a server again before its sad downfall. 


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?  

I feel my biggest weakness is not being active enough during my timezone that during the early mornings. My sleep is really messed up so during my daytime im not usually on but late nights is when I am most active 


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?  

A leader must have for starters must be confident and focused on his/her work. also have passion for what  said leader is doing. I wouldn't consider myself a leader because I am lacking in some skills of said leader such as innovation and such and because if I were to be a leader I want to be the best I can be and for that I still have much to learn 



What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

Well If it helps any I am very into the PVP community and have been since 2012 so I know alot about it allowing me to know if somone is for example using  reach and such. Lately I've been spectating players I find sketchy and then report to a mod and explain my report and usually it does result in a ban. I also 


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

I believe when interacting with the community you should be very transparent and honest and you should listen to the communities feed back/opinions so that you may learn and make a better server/ playing exp around their liking but most of all show respect to the community because they are the reason the server is here in the first place. I believe I have some of these skills by that I mean the respect and listening aspect. I'll admit I lack in the transparency part mostly because of past events that have made me cautious  of players and such 

What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

1. Honesty. being a mod you must be honest in what you see/do and feel against others while also being nice and respectful and if you mess up a punishment or excuse one be honest on why you did so 

2. No being biased. you have to treat every player the same and not treat others with more respect. For example If a friend told you he/she hacked and you just laughed it off and did nothing that is a negative trait you should not have and instead you should punish them like you would any other player.

3. Being Respectful/Mature. No one wants to see a mod going around and dropping f bombs all the time or even cursing out a player and being just downright inappropriate in chat and TS 



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?

I would ask the mod nicely why they are doing so and tell them that's not the way to do it. If they ignored me 

I would get evidence of the mod doing so and report it to a Senior + and allow them to deal with the Mod that is handing out false bans. 


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do?

I would simply ask if they could tone it down abit. because it is a avicus platform and staff disrespect. If they refused I'd suggest to them that they go to a Non-avicus platform to continue their conversation




You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

I would IN STAFF CHAT tell them that posting things that only a staff  member can see is not allowed. Which is why only staff members can read it. I would also delete the msg from the discord hoping not alot of people saw it. If it continued I would tell a Senior+ 



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?

I would get evidence of the senior staff members and report it to a admin such as Crazy or cammy and allow them to handle it since I wouldn't have much power of them 

CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator?

I want to be a mod so that I can help avicus grow into a large server again while also getting rid of the players that make avicus unenjoyable (hackers etc) 

What does Avicus mean to you?

Avicus is the only server I REALLY play now. I've been apart of the community for a couple years now and I would love to support it in any possible way. I would hate to see avicus close or move ownership

Anything specific the staff team could do better?

The only thing the staff team can truly do better is trying to be as active as possible. There are times on avicus where there is no staff on at all. and it tends to get annoying because its usually when all the hackers know to come on other than that lately the avicus staff team has been one of the best yet 

Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?

I chose to apply because I want to help avicus as much as I can and being apart of the staff team is a huge leap into helping avicus grow and be better than ever. Also getting rid of hackers / toxic players is one of the best ways I can help avicus 

Do you have anything else to add to your application?

I would also like to add that I know I'm not the most known or liked player on avicus but I truly do care about the server ( I mean its the only one I really play)  even If I don't make the cut I will continue to always try to help out avicus as much as I can in whatever way I can.
